search_loop: models/forest_lazy.py LazyForestMixin.forward: width loop, offset loop stacks ScoreCell views; selection already width-batched
actual_slots: k1=1; E_w=sum(k_o*k_(w-o)); proposal=min(E_w,R), retained=min(proposal,K), independent of dynamic validity. Masks never shrink physical slots
tensorization: Replace per-offset score/mask stack+pair+cat with cached compact ragged left/right gather indices; keep [B*H,N_w,E_w] and original arithmetic
candidate_identity: span base + row*actual retained slots + slot; bases in width/start order, including invalid slots. Flat enumeration is offset ascending, left slot then right slot
selection_order: proposal exploration rand_like(full priority), scatter deterministic choices
eligible excluding first K-1; optional Delta eligibility
random priorities and Bernoulli beam replacement
RNG: Only torch.rand_like: full proposal priorities, expanded-score random priorities, retained-first-score Bernoulli, per width in that order. No Python/NumPy RNG draws; no per-Span draws
dtype: Scorer/leaf is BF16 under AMP, all width>=2 retained scores FP32. Width2 must add BF16 leaves before .float(); width>=3 has at least one FP32 internal child and uses FP32 promoted addition
autograd: Retained gather score and local logits remain differentiable; detached priority only for discrete selection. Functional immutable width outputs, no detached score search/reconstruction in V3-A
inplace_risks: Never overwrite live packed score bank; cat returns new tensor. In-place scatter only into fresh detached selection/noise/mask buffers as legacy
selection_compatibility: No new sort/tie-break. Existing width-batched topk preserved with same compact candidate length, row order, last-dimension stride and RNG shapes. V3-B should optimize pointers/assembly, not unnecessarily replace already batched selection

stages.A: Cached ragged pairing plus width tensor score bank; retain legacy Cell/root/pointer adapter initially
stages.B: Cache Candidate ID decode/layout; remove normal per-Span Cell creation/root assembly while keeping native selection unchanged
stages.C: Conditional on remaining score backward overhead; no simultaneous score reconstruction

fp32_outer_config_name: Existing PrecisionPolicy uses fp32 rather than disabled; both disable autocast
